artworks.title: Workmen Gathering Ice at the Water's Edge
artworks.artist: Hippolyte Lalaisse
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men moving a horse-drawn cart filled with logs in a wintry landscape. The ground appears rough and icy or snowy. In the background, tall, leafless trees stand out against the low horizon under an overcast sky. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette of various shades of gray, creating a cold, somber atmosphere. The brushstrokes are loose and swift, with a focus on texture and energy. The cart is centrally positioned, with the horse and men adding movement to the composition.

artworks.title: Nessus and Dejanira in Four Poses, and the Dying Nessus
artworks.artist: Hippolyte Lalaisse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring centaurs interacting with human figures. Multiple centaur figures appear in dynamic poses or scenes. The central part shows a centaur clutching a human figure in a dramatic embrace or struggle, surrounded by other centaurs engaging with various human figures or each other. The illustration is created on toned paper, with shading emphasizing the musculature and forms of the figures to convey depth and motion. The positioning of the centaurs and their interactions suggest a narrative rich in mythological elements.

artworks.title: An Ancient Roman Warrior in Battle
artworks.artist: Hippolyte Lalaisse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a muscular male figure from the back, standing in a dynamic pose with a shield raised above his head and holding a sword. The man has wavy hair under a helmet and is surrounded by other figures, including fallen bodies and mounted soldiers in motion, indicating a battle scene. The figure appears naked or minimally clothed, with detailed musculature. The background is filled with sketch lines emphasizing movement and tension.

artworks.title: A Pollard Willow by a Stream
artworks.artist: Hippolyte Lalaisse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on cream wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape drawing viewed from an uneven, natural terrain perspective. The horizon is indicated by a line of trees and landscape features extending into the distance. The artwork shows intricate brushwork of trees and foliage, using fine, detailed strokes to create texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of black against an off-white or cream background. A large twisted tree with sprawling roots is on the left, and more trees and foliage are visible throughout the scene. Some birds are sketched in the sky.
